title: Each part specific, scored on its own
statement: Build each part of an open question so that a vague, generic answer cannot earn credit and the part can be scored on its own.
detail: The short-answer rubric gives full marks when the parts require specific evidence, examples or reasoning, so that generic answers would not earn points (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/prompts/question/saq_evaluation.txt`). It also asks for the expected number of parts, each with a clear task verb, connected to one another but independently scorable (the same file). It governs how the question is built, not how its marking guide is written.

evidence.quote: - Score 1.0: Parts require specific evidence, examples, or reasoning; generic answers would not earn points
- Score 1.0: Has the expected number of parts (check metadata/curriculum context for requirements); each part has a clear task verb; parts are logically connected but independently scorable
Exact-match grading; rubric has no reject boundary
